packages.name: ContentWriter
packages.description: Drafts and revises publication-ready social posts, articles, newsletters, tutorials and case studies from goals, sources or drafts; adapts voice and structure, humanizes prose, and checks evidence and citations.

packages.name: DeepResearcher
packages.description: Researches complex topics using web, scholarly and user-provided sources; produces industry, literature and trend reviews and verifies claims. Delivers auditable reports with citations, confidence, conflicting evidence and limitations.

packages.name: ECommerceResearcher
packages.description: Combines e-commerce product research, listing and review analysis, analytics, creative direction, and operations planning.

packages.name: ImageStudio
packages.description: Creates and edits still visuals: posters, covers, social graphics, infographics, charts and concept art. Prefers zero-call HTML/CSS/SVG for layout and typography; uses configured image models for photos, characters, paintings, textures, hybrid visuals and semantic edits.

packages.name: OfficeWorker
packages.description: Creates, reads, edits, checks and batch-processes Word/DOCX, Excel/XLSX, PowerPoint/PPTX, WPS-compatible files and PDFs, including CSV conversion, formulas, charts and formatting. Not for high-design presentations from scratch or non-office deliverables.

packages.name: PptMaker
packages.description: Creates, edits and reviews native editable PPTX presentations or deck outlines from topics, documents, data, visual references or existing decks. Follows supplied visual direction or develops an audience-led design and checks rendered results.

packages.name: ProductDeveloper
packages.description: Implements clear requirements, PRDs, issues, bugs or designs in a repository, delivering code changes, tests and verification. Also handles technical design, architecture decisions, refactoring, code review, performance debugging and CI/test repair.

packages.name: SeoGeoAgent
packages.description: Audits and improves website SEO/GEO: technical SEO, indexing, structured data, Core Web Vitals, content quality and AI citability. Delivers scores, prioritized actions and dashboards; monitors regressions, fixes supplied repositories with retesting, writes GEO content, and evaluates backlink or guest-post pricing.

packages.name: UIDesigner
packages.description: Designs UI/UX, interaction flows, visual systems and accessible interfaces from briefs, screens, screenshots or Figma references. Delivers design mockups and specs, in HTML by default; not general app development. Repository source stays read-only unless UI edits are explicitly requested; otherwise proposes file-level changes.

packages.name: VideoStudio
packages.description: Creates and edits videos from briefs, reference images or videos, including recreation, explainers, animation, generated footage, avatars and semantic edits. Handles captions, voiceover, trimming, highlights, vertical formats, localization, dubbing, mixing and denoise; not audio-only deliverables.

packages.name: CSV Viewer
packages.description: Open local CSV files, search rows, and sort columns without uploading your data.

packages.name: Notes
packages.description: Create and browse private notes saved on your device.

packages.name: Task Board
packages.description: Create tasks and move them between To do, In progress, and Done.

packages.name: brand-research
packages.description: Research public company, product or brand information for sourced Brand DNA: positioning, audience, competitors, voice, pricing, social proof and content gaps for GTM preparation.

packages.name: content-writer
packages.description: Plan, research, draft, revise, humanize, adapt or audit social posts and long-form content, delivering channel-ready writing or reviews with preserved voice, evidence and citations.

packages.name: data-analysis
packages.description: Analyze quantitative evidence: exact totals, comparisons, experiments and causal uncertainty. Excludes formatting-only work.

packages.name: deep-research
packages.description: Support deep research, literature reviews and citation checks with retrieval budgets, academic search, evidence compression and source/quote/DOI verification, producing comparison and evidence tables.

packages.name: deliverable-review
packages.description: Review a supplied deliverable against requirements and available evidence, distinguishing defects from unverified assumptions.

packages.name: ecommerce-analytics
packages.description: Analyze cross-platform sales, fees, refunds, ads and inventory exports to deliver reproducible operating metrics, drivers and priorities. Use for store performance, contribution profit and channel analysis, not product selection or live changes.

packages.name: ecommerce-creative
packages.description: Create ecommerce image copy, product image prompts, video scripts and storyboards grounded in product facts and source assets. Use for cross-channel creative briefs and experiments, not actual media generation or ad publication.

packages.name: ecommerce-listing
packages.description: Turn product facts into cross-platform titles, benefits, descriptions, keyword placement, FAQs and A+ modules, including page audits and localization. Use for listing writing and optimization, not selection, media generation or live publishing.

packages.name: ecommerce-operations
packages.description: Prepare concrete ecommerce catalog, price, promotion, stock and order-exception changes; apply and verify them only through available connected tools supporting the action. Use for operating changes and previews, not selection, copywriting or analytical diagnosis.

packages.name: ecommerce-product-research
packages.description: Select ecommerce products and assess category opportunities across channels using demand, competition, contribution profit, sourcing and validation costs. Use for product selection, competitor comparison and supplier evaluation, not purchasing or operating-performance reporting.

packages.name: ecommerce-review-analysis
packages.description: Analyze cross-platform product reviews, ratings, follow-ups and support feedback with SKU-level evidence, purchase scenarios, positive drivers, pain themes and action priorities. Use for VOC and competitor feedback, not product selection or full copy production.

packages.name: github
packages.description: Read GitHub issues, pull requests, CI, releases, and repository metadata; perform exact writes authorized by the current request and reconfirm target or scope changes.

packages.name: material-organizer
packages.description: Organize supplied links, files or folders into traceable notes, knowledge cards, entity links and indexes, identifying duplicates, exceptions and folder-cleanup needs.

packages.name: office-excel
packages.description: Create, read, edit and check Excel/XLSX reports, formula models and templates, including CSV conversion, data cleanup, charts and format-preserving changes.

packages.name: office-ppt
packages.description: Create straightforward PowerPoint/PPTX decks, read or safely make small edits to existing presentations, and check content, notes, structure and visible layout.

packages.name: office-word
packages.description: Create, read, edit, and check Word/DOCX reports and templates: preserve styles, numbering, revisions, comments, fields, tables, sections, headers, footers, and layout.

packages.name: pdf-editing
packages.description: Read, create and edit PDFs, including scanned-page reading, page organization, watermarks, text/image overlays, form filling and layout checks.

packages.name: product-dev
packages.description: Deliver verified features, bug fixes, refactors and technical decisions in an existing repository from clear requirements; not vague discovery, disposable demos or repository operations.

packages.name: product-test
packages.description: Turn PRDs, stories or feature slices into stable-ID Given/When/Then acceptance scenarios covering edges, recovery and non-functional criteria; not implementation or test automation.

packages.name: product-ui
packages.description: Design and implement screens, components, landing pages, dashboards or design systems from product needs, flows or design sources, with responsive behavior, accessibility, UI polish and rendered checks.

packages.name: project-brief
packages.description: Turn an objective and supplied materials into a project brief with scope, constraints and observable acceptance criteria.

packages.name: social-data
packages.description: Fetch public Xiaohongshu, X/Twitter, Reddit, YouTube and Bilibili posts, or analyze supplied social/campaign data for sentiment, engagement, CTR, ROI, comparisons and experiments; not publishing.

packages.name: source-synthesis
packages.description: Synthesize supplied materials with traceable references, disagreements and missing information. No autonomous web research.

packages.name: swiftui-dev
packages.description: Review or refactor SwiftUI architecture, state, rendering, scrolling and layout, or diagnose native macOS/iOS hotspots from profiling evidence; not web or server profiling.

packages.name: wps
packages.description: Prepare WPS-compatible DOCX, XLSX, PPTX and PDF deliverables, checking Chinese fonts, A4 layout, numbering, printing and export compatibility.
